This seems adequately covered by RESOLVES_BLOCKING_CONDITION? Or maybe distinct. There's also PROBES_ALTERNATIVE_RESOURCES_AFTER_FAILURE, but that requires an access failure. Here, the resource was successfully downloaded but lacked necessary content, not an access failure. So PROBES_ALTERNATIVE_RESOURCES_AFTER_FAILURE doesn't apply.
